text:
nora (events): Hey folks! Brainstorm: low-key Saturday brunch + boba crawl? idea is 3 stops, short rounds so people can drop in: 1) Sunbean Cafe (boba + savory buns), 2) Maple Diner (brunch plates), 3) Puzzle Parlor (board games + coffee). Start time 11:00 or 11:45? small group (6-10). RSVP + any dietary notes. :bubble_tea: :pancakes: :game_die:

max: Love it. 11:00 for me. can bring Codenames and Splendor if we do Puzzle Parlor.

anya: 11:45 works better (yoga class beforehand). vegetarian here, no mushrooms pls. happy to bring oat milk for boba.

rik: Sunbean -> Maple sounds like a fun loop. 11:00 is best for me. ill bring a travel chess set.

jules: I'm in for board games but early afternoon only. 11:45 prefer. also gluten-free option needed.

samir: leaning Diner first (good for breakfast hunger). either time ok. can handle a small sign-up if we lock spots.

nora (events): Ok split on time. putting up a quick ops-bot poll for spot order + start time. If Sunbean first i'll confirm a small table for 8; Puzzle Parlor i'll reserve two tables for games. If Maple first i'll ask for a high-top near the window.

ops-bot: Poll: "Boba + Brunch + Board - pick start & order"  Sunbean -> Maple -> Puzzle  3 votes  11:00  Maple -> Sunbean -> Puzzle  2 votes  11:45  Puzzle -> Sunbean -> Maple  1 vote (ends in 16h)

anya: if Sunbean first, can someone grab us a table inside? the patio gets windy.

max: if Puzzle Parlor is last i can set up the game rotation sheet so people can join quick rounds.

jules: thanks Nora for thinking of GF options. ill DM menu recs if we lock a place.

nora (events): sweet. poll ends overnight; i'll lock winners tomorrow morning and post a calendar invite + quick game sign-up link. please react to ops-bot if you haven't voted. excited for a chill weekend hang! :sparkles:
